events.name: Six Degrees of Santa
events.description: Christmas enthusiast and single mother Harper creates a program dubbed Six Degrees of Santa in which anonymous 'Santas' give a gift to be passed along, temporarily enjoyed, and re-gifted indefinitely. Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund

events.name: Six Degrees of Santa
events.description: Christmas enthusiast and single mother Harper creates a program dubbed Six Degrees of Santa in which anonymous 'Santas' give a gift to be passed along, temporarily enjoyed, and re-gifted indefinitely. Her goal is to create a Christmas experience that's real-life, magical, and unexpected. When Harper's own gift lands in the hands of leading internet entrepreneur Jason, he's convinced that the original Santa might be his soul mate. He seeks out Harper, as the architect of the program, to help him track down this mystery woman. Romantic comedy, starring Kathryn Davis and Steve Lund

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. The last meeting between the sides came here 12 months ago, when the visitors scored seven tries in a 52-26 triumph. Commentary comes from Gareth Rhys Owen, Shane Williams, and Jamie Roberts, with analysis by Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton, and Dan Biggar

England are all but certain of a place in the quarter-finals, but their opponents will be determined to restore some pride this evening and boost their chances of avoiding relegation to League B. With analysis by Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary from Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by reporter Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw

events.name: Nations Championship
events.description: England v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' opening match in the Northern Hemisphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay

England produced a stunning display to win the reverse fixture 7-0 in Rijeka, with braces by Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka and strikes from Jude Bellingham, Anthony Gordon and Morgan Rogers subjecting the Croatians to their heaviest ever defeat. England are all but certain of a place in the quarter-finals, but their opponents will be determined to restore some pride this evening and boost their chances of avoiding relegation to League B. With analysis by Roy Keane and Ian Wright, commentary from Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, and interviews by reporter Gabriel Clarke

events.name: James Martin's American Adventure
events.description: The chef ends his coast-to-coast exploration of the US in New York City. After a bite of pizza at a popular pizzeria in Greenwich Village, James cooks on one of the city's famous piers. New York has a wealth of French fine-dining restaurants, and the chef cannot wait to take a bite of the action. He chooses his favourite pair, Daniel, run by his old mate Daniel Boulud, and Le Bernadine, where Eric Ripart is in charge. At the end of the day, James cooks back on the pier as sunset approaches and he reminisces on his journey of more than 3,000 miles

events.description: Wales v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the Northern Hemisphere Series match at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Wales have not defeated the All Blacks since 1953, with New Zealand winning 34 consecutive matches against them since then. events.name: Lake District Rescue
events.description: Documentary about the Lake District Mountain Rescue Association. From paragliders crashing into the mountainside, to scramblers who have fallen down waterfalls or adventurers becoming lost in the tunnel systems of disused quarries, the volunteers will drop everything to head out to the hills and bring home the lost, injured and stricken. In this episode, the team is dispatched to help a man with a dislocated shoulder at the popular Eskdale Pools. Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

events.name: Case Sensitive
events.description: Part one of two. New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

events.name: Lake District Rescue
events.description: Documentary about the Lake District Mountain Rescue Association. From paragliders crashing into the mountainside, to scramblers who have fallen down waterfalls or adventurers becoming lost in the tunnel systems of disused quarries, the volunteers will drop everything to head out to the hills and bring home the lost, injured and stricken. In this episode, the team is dispatched to help a man with a dislocated shoulder at the popular Eskdale Pools. Miles from the nearest road, the challenge of how to transport him to a hospital is a dilemma for team leader John

events.name: Case Sensitive
events.description: Part one of two. New DS Charlie Zailer finds herself working with DC Simon Waterhouse for the first time when Geraldine Bretherick and her five-year-old daughter Lucy are found dead in the bathroom of their luxury home, and the two argue about whether the case is one of murder, suicide or something more sinister. Meanwhile, a woman tells her best friend she had an affair with Bretherick's husband and wants to see him again. Thriller, based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah, starring Olivia Williams, Darren Boyd, Rupert Graves and Amy Beth Hayes

events.description: Camille is a prostitute living in Paris who falls in love with a promising young man named Armand Duval. events.description: Young Nigel Slater has big culinary aspirations, even though all his mother knows how to make is toast. When his mother dies, relations grow strained between Nigel and his father, especially when he remarries a woman who wins his heart with a lemon meringue pie. events.name: Big Momma's House
events.description: Comedy starring Martin Lawrence and Nia Long. FBI agent Malcolm Turner is a master of disguise, but even his skills are put to the test when he has to impersonate larger-than-life southern matriarch Big Momma Pierce in order to catch a psychopathic bank robber.

events.name: Ideal Home
events.description: Paul Rudd and Steve Coogan -the kings of comedy come together for this must-see film. A big screen match made in heaven in this poignant and endearing comedy as they play a bickering, and flamboyant, couple (with an extensive erotic film collection) whose lavish life is thrown in to turmoil with the sudden appearance of their long-lost grandson. Will the pair be able to take on this new challenge?
